title: Korea Stock Market Today, Oct 30, 2026: KOSPI -3.48%, KOSDAQ -3.83% as Alphabet Plunge Hits Chip Stocks
content:
KOSPI closed at 5,730.74, down 3.48%, and KOSDAQ closed at 724.38, down 3.83%, after Alphabet's sharp drop in New York set off heavy selling in large chip stocks and a sell-side sidecar was triggered on KOSPI during the session. Individual themes moved on their own news: cybersecurity stocks rose after a major security incident at Binance, chip equipment and substrate names fell with the sector, and some large pharmaceutical and biotech names held up better than the market.

1. U.S. tech stocks tumble — KOSPI and KOSDAQ fall together, sell-side sidecar triggered

Overnight in the U.S., Alphabet fell 12.6% after its third-quarter results, on worries that higher AI investment is weighing on cash flow and profitability. Amazon and Intel also weakened in after-hours trading on disappointment over results and outlook, raising doubts about whether the huge cost of AI investment will turn into real profit. The Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also fell, weighing on Korean large chip stocks.

KOSPI opened down 2.99% at 5,760.35 and at one point fell to around 5,599, a drop of 5.7%. A sell-side sidecar was triggered at 10:04 a.m. as KOSPI 200 futures plunged. The index later recovered part of the drop and closed at 5,730.74 (-3.48%), while KOSDAQ closed at 724.38 (-3.83%).

2. Major security incident at Binance — cybersecurity stocks in focus

Cybersecurity stocks rose on news of a major security incident at Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange. The estimated impact is about $6.3 billion, which drew attention as the largest crypto security incident on record. The impact figure Binance cited has not been confirmed as the final net amount stolen, and the cause and the size of the damage are still under investigation. Binance said it froze about $3 billion in assets and said it would make customers whole for any losses.

As worries about security incidents have spread from banks to brokerages and now to a crypto exchange, expectations rose for stronger security systems and more demand for responding to cyberattacks at financial institutions and exchanges.

AhnLab, Raon Secure, Genians and Monitorapp were in focus, and SGA Solutions hit its upper limit. SGA Solutions had also announced emergency support for server antivirus and security solutions against the recent PHP vulnerability known as "PHP2Shell," which served as an additional catalyst.

3. Large chip stocks plunge — AI investment profitability worries and profit-taking

As the cost burden of U.S. big tech's AI investment came into focus, selling concentrated in Korean large chip stocks. Despite SK hynix's record results and shareholder return announcement and Samsung Electronics' record earnings release, the market appeared to be testing how far expanded AI investment will translate into real memory demand and company profit.

Samsung Electronics and SK hynix fell together, and SK Square and Samsung Electro-Mechanics were also weak. Chip equipment, substrate and back-end names saw selling spread on weaker sentiment across the sector.

Substrate and PCB names Daeduck Electronics and Simmtech, and test and back-end names TSE, Okins Electronics and Intekplus, fell sharply. Nearly every sub-theme in the chip sector, including HBM and next-generation memory, system chips, substrates and equipment, was weak that day.

4. Pharma and biotech hold up — defensive appeal in a falling market

While selling concentrated on chip and growth stocks, buying came into some large pharmaceutical and biotech names. Samsung Biologics and Hanmi Pharmaceutical rose against the weak market, showing a split within the sector.

Hanmi Pharmaceutical reported third-quarter consolidated revenue of 377.4 billion won, up 4.2% from a year earlier, and a 9.7% increase in standalone operating profit. Consolidated operating profit fell on a base effect from a technology transfer upfront payment booked in the previous quarter, but growth in prescription sales of its main domestic drugs and expectations of a recovery at Beijing Hanmi drew attention.

Samsung Biologics also held up relatively well in the sell-off. No new single disclosure explaining its gain was confirmed, and selective flows into large pharma and biotech names in a risk-off market appear to have played a role.

Quick FAQ

How did KOSPI and KOSDAQ close on Oct 30?
KOSPI fell 3.48% to 5,730.74 and KOSDAQ fell 3.83% to 724.38. KOSPI's intraday drop reached about 5.7%, and a sell-side sidecar was triggered at 10:04 a.m.

Why did Korean stocks plunge?
Alphabet fell 12.6% overnight after its third-quarter results on AI investment profitability worries, and Amazon and Intel also weakened, raising doubts about whether AI spending will turn into profit.

Has the Binance loss been confirmed?
No. The impact is estimated at about $6.3 billion, but that whole amount has not been confirmed as net stolen, and the cause and damage are under investigation.
